glossary.definition: (1) "Methamphetamine" means methamphetamine, any salt, isomer, or salt of an isomer of methamphetamine, or any compound, mixture, preparation, or substance containing methamphetamine or any salt, isomer, or salt of an isomer of methamphetamine.
glossary.source_title: Section 3745.13 - Costs of dealing with unauthorized spill, release or discharge.

glossary.definition: (2) "Illegal methamphetamine manufacturing laboratory" means any laboratory or other premises that is used for the manufacture or production of methamphetamine in violation of section 2925.04 of the Revised Code, whether or not there has been a prior conviction of that violation.
glossary.source_title: Section 3745.13 - Costs of dealing with unauthorized spill, release or discharge.
